research.name: Shader Lab
research.note: Browser WebGPU editor for stacking and keyframing shader effect layers over video, with a React runtime to embed exports.

effects: layer stack of shader effects (ASCII, dithering, pixel trail, displacement map, progressive blur, bloom) composited over video and text
blob tracking layer that frames moving regions with CCTV-style shapes, labels and trails
timeline with keyframes and audio-linked parameters
exported compositions usable as a React component, a texture or postprocessing
